about_the_game:
Dusty Beakman (Intern-D5073)

First Day at 100% Clean Inc.

This pigeon who dreams of becoming the company's top employee arrives for orientation, only to find the building deserted. A strange voice echoes through the PA system as...

You will face:

- Monsters surge from every corridor

- Bizarre weapons & tools appear in offices

- Custom weapon crafting system

- Frenetic combat sequences

Wield your plunger and water gun to purge the oil-based horrors infesting this office building!
